related.title: Google WIF：共享 issuer 的租戶隔離
related.titleEn: Google WIF: tenant isolation under a shared issuer
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：兩種比例可重算，大小寫反例及錯受眾例均保留；修復不得將三欄AND換成任一欄符合即可。 交付九列federation-contract.csv、字串差異與版本時間線；報告不得包含可用的真實bearer token。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce both percentages and retain case and wrong-audience counterexamples. The repair must not replace the three-field AND with acceptance when any single field matches. Deliver nine federation-contract rows, string differences and a configuration timeline. Include claim descriptors only, never a usable real bearer token or an actual client credential.
related.difference: 製作A、B兩個虛構組織各八筆token描述，讓兩邊都有build角色；列issuer、organization ID、repository ID與映射subject，找出僅以角色名映射的碰撞。
related.differenceEn: Create eight token descriptors for each of fictional organizations A and B, both containing a build role. Tabulate issuer, organization ID, repository ID and mapped subject to expose role-name-only collisions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 已通過簽章檢查的token仍須符合預期issuer、subject和audience；對本課標準精確比對憑證採大小寫敏感的三欄AND，不以正規化掩蓋設定差異。 九筆中4筆三欄皆正確；修正兩筆設定的subject大小寫後，在相同token與簽章前提下有6筆符合。 符合比例4/9×100=44.4444444%；修正後6/9×100=66.6666667%。錯tenant與錯audience仍必須拒絕。
映射身分與授權條件是不同層次；不可因簽章來自共同issuer就信任其所有租戶。組織識別使用固定測試ID，顯示名稱只作說明。 共16筆，單看共同issuer全數符合；加上A組織條件後8筆符合，再加受控repository條件只剩5筆。 組織限定後8/16×100=50%；再限定repository後5/16×100=31.25%。縮小可用集合不是偵測率或服務可用性量測。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A signature-valid token must still match expected issuer, subject and audience. The standard exact-match credential in this exercise uses case-sensitive three-field AND conditions rather than normalization that hides configuration differences. Four of nine tuples match all three fields. Correcting subject case in two configuration entries yields six matches against the same tokens, with signature-validation outcomes unchanged. Matching share is 4/9×100=44.4444444%, increasing to 6/9×100=66.6666667%. Another tenant and an incorrect audience remain rejected regardless of that improved fixture statistic.

Identity mapping and authorization conditions are distinct layers. Trusting a shared issuer's signature does not authorize every tenant. Use fixed fictional organization IDs; display names are explanatory metadata, not the sole trust anchor. All 16 fixtures match the common issuer. Requiring organization A leaves eight; additionally requiring the approved repository leaves five. Every count refers to this enumerated synthetic set. Organization restriction gives 8/16×100=50%; adding repository restriction gives 5/16×100=31.25%. This reduced eligible set is neither a detection rate nor a measured service-availability figure.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: DTLS 1.3：亂序容忍與重複紀錄視窗
related.titleEn: DTLS 1.3: reordering tolerance and duplicate-record windows
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：兩種比例可重算，大小寫反例及錯受眾例均保留；修復不得將三欄AND換成任一欄符合即可。 交付九列federation-contract.csv、字串差異與版本時間線；報告不得包含可用的真實bearer token。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce both percentages and retain case and wrong-audience counterexamples. The repair must not replace the three-field AND with acceptance when any single field matches. Deliver nine federation-contract rows, string differences and a configuration timeline. Include claim descriptors only, never a usable real bearer token or an actual client credential.
related.difference: 以epoch、序號及已見位元建立接收狀態；準備新紀錄、視窗內未見亂序、已見重複與太舊紀錄四類，所有封包僅為離線整數描述。
related.differenceEn: Model receiver state with epoch, sequence number and seen bits. Prepare fresh records, unseen in-window reordering, seen duplicates and too-old records, represented solely as offline integers rather than captured or injected network traffic.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 已通過簽章檢查的token仍須符合預期issuer、subject和audience；對本課標準精確比對憑證採大小寫敏感的三欄AND，不以正規化掩蓋設定差異。 九筆中4筆三欄皆正確；修正兩筆設定的subject大小寫後，在相同token與簽章前提下有6筆符合。 符合比例4/9×100=44.4444444%；修正後6/9×100=66.6666667%。錯tenant與錯audience仍必須拒絕。
本課寬度W的含端點視窗為[H−W+1,H]；已見重複拒絕，未見且在窗內可接受。驗證標記只能在記錄認證成功後更新。 最高已認證序號H=1040，寬度W=64，兩個epoch分開維護；低界只是容量計算，不直接表示某筆紀錄一定未見。 最低窗內序號1040−64+1=977；擴窗至128後為913。接受與否仍依認證、epoch及重複位元，不能只比較數字。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A signature-valid token must still match expected issuer, subject and audience. The standard exact-match credential in this exercise uses case-sensitive three-field AND conditions rather than normalization that hides configuration differences. Four of nine tuples match all three fields. Correcting subject case in two configuration entries yields six matches against the same tokens, with signature-validation outcomes unchanged. Matching share is 4/9×100=44.4444444%, increasing to 6/9×100=66.6666667%. Another tenant and an incorrect audience remain rejected regardless of that improved fixture statistic.

The selected inclusive window is [H−W+1,H] for width W and highest authenticated sequence H. Reject seen duplicates and allow unseen in-window records. Update seen state only after record authentication succeeds, preventing unauthenticated metadata from advancing the model. Set highest authenticated sequence H to 1040 and width W to 64. Maintain independent state for two epochs. The lower bound describes capacity, not whether a particular record has already been accepted. The lowest in-window sequence is 1040−64+1=977. Expanding to 128 moves it to 913. Admission still depends on authentication, epoch and the duplicate bit; a numerical bound alone is insufficient.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
